Messages.Author: Chuck Corley
Messages.Body:
So, color me curious, say Gilbert Duane Governs the Unaligned at the
Inferior, and I reply to it with having Quira and Ozmo Telepathic
Counter all the Bleed. Does he still have to expend the blood for the
Govern, or is it still considered unsuccessful despite my soaking up
the Govern the Unaligned with the Counters?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


He spends a blood - the action is successful (unblocked) even though the
bleed is not (a bleed must be for 1 or more to be successful).

>In the above case
<Telepathic Counter reducing a bleed to zero>

No.

"The next time this vampire successfully bleeds the same Methuselah,
burn this card for +2 bleed."

The bleed already has to be successful for Spying Mission to kick in.
